description: This file defines a PDF processing class that extracts text and images from PDF documents, chunking text into manageable pieces and saving images locally.

classes.name: PDFProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing PDF files to extract structured text and images, and saving images to a designated directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the PDFProcessor, setting up the images directory.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Main method to process a PDF file, extracting text chunks and images, organized by chapter and page.

methods.name: _chunk_text
methods.description: Splits extracted text into chunks with overlap, based on paragraph length and size settings.
